name: @openshapeforge/example-plugin-workflow
description: Example plugin: workflow node catalogs and the workflow runtime (generators + platform tables + authoring layer + runtime module).
//dependencies: kysely is a real dependency of the runtime half, which queries the workflow tables directly. zod validates a node's resolved config against the catalog's field schema before a bridge runs; cron-parser computes the next fire for a schedule trigger. @restatedev/restate-sdk types the virtual object in runtime/command-runtime.ts, which is the optional durable-execution envelope around the three command-apply functions — the runtime imports it only when a deployment selects that dispatcher. react is the web half's: web/ ships JSX that apps/web renders, and `jsx: react-jsx` resolves react/jsx-runtime from here, not from the app. All must be declared here rather than borrowed from apps/api or apps/web: a bare specifier does not resolve from examples/. Keep the kysely range in step with apps/api — they share a connection — and react PINNED to apps/web's exact version, because two React copies in one render tree is a runtime error, not a version skew.
